remarks:
There are houses, and then there are houses that make you stop in the driveway and take it all in. 4966 Sheridan Drive is one of those houses.

From the stately architecture to the beautifully landscaped front lawn, this custom home has a majestic presence. A sweeping double-wide driveway offers ample parking, while the rare 4.5-car garage gives you space for vehicles and more. And that is only the beginning.

Open the front door to a soaring two-story foyer and grand chandelier that set the tone for everything ahead. Maple floors bring warmth to the living room, dining room, kitchen, and light-filled breakfast room. The kitchen is designed to be enjoyed, with quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, a walk-in pantry, and a breakfast bar where everyone will inevitably gather. In the family room, a stacked-stone wood-burning fireplace creates a cozy place to settle in. First-floor laundry adds convenience to a home built for living as well as entertaining.

Then step outside. This backyard deserves more than a quick glance at the pool. Winding areas of lush landscaping surround multiple places to sit, gather, and unwind. Spend the afternoon in the heated saltwater pool, move to the hot tub as the evening cools, host dinner beneath the covered patio, or find a quiet spot among the trees and gardens. With a vinyl privacy fence and a lot just under half an acre, the whole setting feels like your own private escape.

Three bedrooms, two full baths, one half bath, and a location in the Williamsville School District complete the picture. The front makes a grand first impression. The backyard makes you want to stay.
